fig1_packet_propagation.svg: A Gaussian packet ($x_0=-8,\,p_0=2,\,\sigma=1$, $\hbar=m=1$) evolved by the free propagator $\Psi(x,t)=\int K_0\,\Psi_0\,dx'$ (propagate) at $t=0,4,8$. The centre drifts at the group velocity $v=p_0/m=2$ (dotted lines) while the width spreads as $\sigma(t)=\sigma\sqrt{1+(\hbar t/2m\sigma^2)^2}$. Open markers are an independent split-step FFT solve of the TDSE (evolve_free_spectral) — the two agree to 5e-10.
fig2_path_integral_convergence.svg: The harmonic-oscillator imaginary-time kernel $K_E(x;x'{=}-1,\tau{=}1)$ ($V=\tfrac12 x^2$, $\omega=1$) built by the Trotter sum-over-paths $(D_{V/2}FD_{V/2})^N$ (path_integral_euclidean) for $N=1,2,8$ slices, converging to the closed-form Mehler kernel (harmonic_propagator_euclidean, dashed). One slice is crude; by $N=8$ the discretised path integral has reproduced the exact propagator — Trotter error falls as $O(1/N^2)$.
